title: Add debug logging for discarded button presses
description: The while rx.try_recv().is_ok() {} loop silently discards presses. Add debug log to show how many were discarded for debugging.

title: Simplify main loop by removing pending_press variable
description: Handle welcome on startup separately, then use simple loop: rx.recv() to block, drain extras, handle press. Eliminates confusing pending_press flag.

title: Verify state machine implementation matches documentation
description: After implementing enum state machine (lego-radio-cq8), verify the code matches docs/state-machine.md diagrams. Check: 1) All state transitions are correct, 2) Welcome/Playing/Off states behave as documented, 3) Edge cases (wrap-around, first boot) work correctly. Update docs if implementation differs.

title: Replace channel_idx integer with enum state machine
description: Current state uses magic numbers (-1, 0, 1-N, N+1). Replace with explicit enum: RadioState { Welcome, Playing(usize), Off }. This eliminates the -1 hack and makes transitions explicit.

title: Remove redundant player.stop() call in channel switch
description: In run_radio(), channel switch calls player.stop() then player.play_stream() which internally calls stop() again. Remove the redundant first stop() call.

title: Update state machine documentation
description: Fix inaccuracies: 1) Channel1 shows 'Stop previous stream' but from Welcome there is none, 2) 'Restart' should say 'Exit (systemd restarts)', 3) Add note about increment-before-check pattern, 4) Simplify repetitive channel diagrams
close_reason: Updated state-machine.md with fixes: unified Playing state, fixed Exit description, added increment-before-check explanation, documented both TTS methods

title: Fix help text to match actual channel flow
description: Help says 'Channels cycle: 1 → 2 → 3 → ... → OFF → 1' but actual flow is 'Welcome → 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → OFF → Welcome'. Update print_help() in main.rs.
